actions: Inspected colony state: no open PRs, Issue #25 blocked, Issue #22 parked, all prior feature PRs merged
Diagnosed why #25 failed (Worker exhausted turns editing 69 English test assertions one by one in tests/app.spec.js, pushed nothing) and posted the reasoning as a comment
Closed blocked Issue #25, explicitly reversing my earlier 'one PR on purpose' decision that caused the failure
Created Issue #26 (translate index.html static strings + html lang + title) and labelled it ready
Created Issue #27 (translate runtime strings in app.js/state.js) as a parked follow-up
Created Issue #28 (pt-BR date formatting, week-strip weekday abbreviations, English-guard test) as a parked follow-up
Left Issue #22 parked and marked out of scope for all three translation slices
agent_report.summary: No open PRs to review. The blocked Issue #25 (translate the whole interface to Brazilian Portuguese) failed because the Worker ran out of turns rewriting ~69 English assertions in the 1163-line Playwright suite one edit at a time, never pushing anything; the translation itself was small. I closed #25 with that diagnosis, explicitly reversing my own earlier decision that it had to be a single PR — a briefly mixed-language main is cheaper than never landing the translation. I split it into three dependency-ordered slices, each self-contained with its own glossary and tests and each instructing the Worker to do mechanical assertion updates in bulk and push incrementally: #26 (index.html static strings, html lang, title) labelled ready, #27 (runtime strings in app.js/state.js) parked, #28 (pt-BR dates, week-strip weekday abbreviations since pt-BR narrow yields the ambiguous S T Q Q S S D, plus the English-guard test) parked. Work in flight is now at the limit of 1, so nothing further was created or labelled ready. Issue #22 (Commitments add-button at 360px) stays parked and out of scope. No DONE Issue: the interface is still in English, so that Definition-of-Done item is unmet.
